endpoints.description: Fetch the compact agent-readable guide to the packaging-strength atlas, source boundaries, and key public routes.
endpoints.response_description: Plain-text guide covering canonical URLs, data files, safe-use notes, and source boundaries.

endpoints.description: Enumerate crawlable packaging-strength pages and machine-readable sidecars.
endpoints.response_description: XML sitemap with signal pages, board-family pages, material pages, format pages, SKU pages, and public sidecars.

endpoints.description: Download public Packrift packaging-strength evidence rows.
endpoints.response_description: JSON rows containing public SKU, product URL, extracted strength signals, dimensions, cube, weight, price snapshot, and availability snapshot fields.

endpoints.description: Fetch release counts for records, strength signals, signal edges, board families, materials, and formats.
endpoints.response_description: JSON release statistics for the Packaging Strength Evidence Atlas.

endpoints.description: Read a representative signal page for ECT-32 packaging records.
endpoints.response_description: HTML signal page listing Packrift public records with extracted ECT-32 evidence.

endpoints.description: Read a representative signal page for 2.5 mil film evidence records.
endpoints.response_description: HTML signal page listing Packrift public records with extracted 2.5 mil film evidence.

snapshot.agent_notes: This atlas is a read-only public packaging-strength evidence reference. No account, login, API key, token, payment, or password is required to read the public files. It is not a live quote, inventory promise, checkout total, supplier-cost disclosure, margin disclosure, customer record, or substitute recommendation. Use Packrift.com checkout and Packrift MCP for live price, inventory, shipping, cart, and order decisions.
snapshot.description: Public Packrift packaging-strength evidence reference that normalizes ECT ratings, wall construction, film thickness, gauge, and durability signals for procurement agents, crawlers, and buyer review.
